intro.h2: Design, permits and build under one Minneapolis roof
paragraphs: Red Fox Remodeling handles kitchen remodeling Minneapolis and St. Paul homeowners plan around, along with bathrooms, basements and additions. Founder Denny Meints started the company in 2022 after years in remodeling and construction management, and built it on integrity, transparent pricing and quality craftsmanship.

Many of the projects on its site are older St. Paul homes, where new hardwood, millwork and siding were matched to the original so the work looks like it was always there. Each service page lists a starting price, so you can tell early whether your budget fits. Google reviewers keep using the same words: communication, integrity and craftsmanship.

services.h2: What Red Fox builds, with starting prices

items.name: Kitchens
items.blurb: Custom kitchens designed around how your family cooks and gathers, from walnut cabinetry and marble tops to butcher block and brick floors. Kitchens start at $75,000 and typically run $90,000 to $200,000. Most full kitchen remodels take about 10 weeks of construction.

image.alt: Garden Cottage kitchen in St. Paul with sage green cabinets, butcher block counters, open shelves and brick floor

items.name: Bathrooms
items.blurb: Primary baths, family baths and tight powder rooms, with features like heated floors, wet rooms that pair tub and shower behind glass, and marble or handmade tile. Bathrooms start at $65,000, typically range up to $150,000, and take about 6 to 8 weeks of construction.

image.alt: Family bathroom in a historic St. Paul home with walnut vanity, brass fixtures and a freestanding tub in a glass wet room

items.name: Basement Finishing
items.blurb: Rec rooms, guest suites, offices and bathrooms, from waterproofing to final trim. A full basement with a bathroom, bedroom and living space tends to cost around $100,000, with basements starting at $95,000. Design takes 1 to 2 months and construction 3 to 4 months.

image.alt: Finished basement with a sectional sofa, wet bar with white cabinets, open shelves and wood-look floor

items.name: Additions
items.blurb: Additions designed to disappear into the original house, with matched siding, windows and roofing. Additions start at $200,000. Expect nine to twelve weeks of design, four to six weeks of preparation, and four to eight months of building, depending on size.

image.alt: Executive Craftsman addition project in St. Paul with a new kitchen island and peninsula, white cabinets and brass pendants

items.name: Whole Home Remodels
items.blurb: Every room reworked into one plan, from structural changes to finish details. Whole-home projects start at $350,000. Without structural changes they can finish in four or five months, while larger scopes run eight or nine months. Red Fox can also price a house before you buy it.

image.alt: Burnsville whole-home remodel living room with skylights, white brick fireplace and wall of windows

why_choose_us.h2: Why Twin Cities homeowners hire Red Fox

items.title: Prices you can see first
items.text: Red Fox posts starting prices for kitchens, baths, basements, additions and whole homes, and promises transparent pricing through the whole project so you always know where you stand.

items.title: A team with named roles
items.text: Lead designer Mai See Thao, project manager Asher Webb, site supervisor Wade Kyllonen and estimator Chad Torp each bring years of experience to a defined part of your job.

items.title: You always know what is next
items.text: An app-based customer portal and a dedicated project manager keep you informed. One reviewer wrote that Red Fox "communicates clearly and honestly and delivers the promised outcome."

items.title: Award-winning, licensed work
items.text: Red Fox holds a NARI Minnesota Silver award for a residential kitchen, a Minnesota's Best Readers' Choice Bronze for 2025 and a Chrysalis Award. It is licensed (BC799282), a NARI member and EPA lead certified.

about.h2: Meet Denny Meints and his team
about.text: Denny Meints founded Red Fox Remodeling in 2022 after years of experience in home remodeling and construction management. He runs operations and leads a team based on 16th Avenue SE in Minneapolis. Reviewers mention him by name, saying Denny walks you through the process and makes sure the work is done right. Writing about a historic St. Paul addition, Denny said the team "especially loved the challenge of carrying the original home's historic details into every part of the addition."

image.alt: Denny Meints, founder of Red Fox Remodeling in Minneapolis

process.h2: Four steps from first call to finished room

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.text: Tell Red Fox about your project and budget by phone or through the consultation form, and the team sets up a first conversation.

steps.title: Discovery and design
steps.text: The team learns your vision and budget, then builds an initial design and estimate and refines it with you until it is approved.

steps.title: Prepare and plan
steps.text: Red Fox pulls the permits, coordinates trade partners and sources every material so all of it is ready before construction starts.

steps.title: Build and celebrate
steps.text: Your project manager keeps you updated through the app-based portal, with walkthroughs and final touch-ups before the finished space is yours.

service_area.h2: Remodeling across Minneapolis and St. Paul
service_area.text: Red Fox works out of an office at 1153 16th Ave SE in Minneapolis and serves homeowners across the Twin Cities. Its featured projects, including Executive Craftsman, Sophisticated Living, Garden Cottage and Emerald Retreat, are all in St. Paul, many in historic homes on established blocks. If you are weighing a house in a particular neighborhood, the team can give general price guidance before you buy.

faq.h2: Kitchen remodeling Minneapolis questions, answered with real numbers

items.q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost with Red Fox?
items.a: It depends on scope, design and selections. As a general guide, Red Fox says kitchen remodels typically range from $90,000 to $200,000, with projects starting around $75,000 for a more basic scope. Pricing stays transparent through design and construction, so you know where the project stands at each step.

items.q: How long does a kitchen remodel take?
items.a: Most full kitchen remodels take about 10 weeks of construction. Counting design, selections, permits and ordering, the whole process often runs 6 to 8 months from the first consultation. Red Fox suggests you start planning 3 to 6 months before you want construction to begin, because custom cabinets can have long lead times.

items.q: What does a bathroom remodel cost, and how long does it take?
items.a: A bathroom remodel with Red Fox typically ranges from $65,000 to $150,000. Construction usually takes 6 to 8 weeks. Larger primary bathrooms with layout changes, custom tile or specialty materials can take longer, and specialty materials can have long lead times, so plan ahead.

items.q: Can we live at home during the work?
items.a: For kitchens, in most cases yes, though you may need to move out for part of the project depending on scope. For a bathroom, you can stay throughout if the house has more than one bathroom. For a whole-home remodel, plan to relocate for at least part of the work, which also shortens the schedule.

items.q: Do you work on older and historic homes?
items.a: Yes. Most featured projects are historic St. Paul houses. In one, new hardwood floors and custom millwork were matched to the original home, and an addition used matching siding, windows and roofing. Another restored character lost in a 1990s renovation with new millwork, butcher block counters and a brick floor.

final_cta.h2: Talk with Red Fox about your kitchen
final_cta.text: Call (612) 208-2794 or start a free consultation online. Share your budget and the team will tell you what it can build.
